title: Payment plan term extension after a CGM hardship approval: Urology and Continence Supply Program
content:
A payment plan for the balance of a Continence Commercial HMO Program of the Urology and Continence Supply Program runs longer when the customer's Continuous Glucose Monitoring Supply Program carries an approved hardship application.

## Extension

- When the customer's Continuous Glucose Monitoring Supply Program carries a hardship application that is approved and was received within the last 12 calendar months, 4 months are added to the term.
- When the newest such approved application was received within the last 24 calendar months but not the last 12, 2 months are added.
- Otherwise nothing is added.

The newest approved application is the approved hardship application with the latest received date on the Continuous Glucose Monitoring Supply Program. "Within the last 12 calendar months" means received fewer than 12 whole calendar months before the plan is accepted, and 24 months is read the same way.

## Cases (hypothetical)

| Newest approved CGM hardship application received before acceptance | Months added |
|---|---|
| 3 months | 4 |
| 11 whole months and some days | 4 |
| 12 whole months | 2 |
| 20 months | 2 |
| 24 whole months, or no approved application | 0 |
